description: ESPHome is an open-source system to control ESP8266/ESP32 microcontrollers through simple yet powerful YAML configuration files and manage them remotely through home automation systems. Its web dashboard, the ESPHome Device Builder, lets you create, edit, validate and compile custom firmware and install it wirelessly (OTA) from the browser.
name: ESPHome
seoDescription: Deploy ESPHome with Docker Compose on Dokploy — build custom ESP32/ESP8266 firmware from YAML in the web dashboard and install it over the air.
